name: Fort Collins
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fort Collins for 2026, and here is what he found: 18 family events, 6 of them free. The magic runs from the Winter Lights Scavenger Hunt and Santa photos at Foothills (starting November 26 and 27) through the Old Town Square skate rink and the SnowDome Holiday Show in December, with the Nutcracker ballets at The Lincoln Center (December 4 to 20), the NightLights Tree Lighting Celebration (December 1), Santa's reindeer at Bath Garden Center (December 5, 12 and 19) and TUBA Christmas (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fort Collins

  • 18 Christmas events for kids in Fort Collins, Bellvue and the Poudre Canyon
  • 6 free events, including the NightLights Tree Lighting Celebration, TUBA Christmas, the Old Town Square skate rink and the Winter Lights Scavenger Hunt
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Arrival at Old Town Square, Santa's Workshop, Santa photos at Foothills (November 27 to December 24), Santa's reindeer at Bath Garden Center (December 5, 12 and 19) and Santa Claus Live at The Mish (December 12 and 13)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the NightLights Tree Lighting Celebration (December 1) and the downtown holiday lights
  • Shows: four Nutcracker productions and Dickens' Holiday Spectacular at The Lincoln Center, plus the SnowDome Holiday Show at the Fort Collins Museum of Discovery
  • Season: November 26 to December 31

Planning a bigger day out? Fort Collins families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Denver and Boulder, which covers the big Colorado holiday lights and shows along the Front Range.
